verdict.rationale: MotherDuck supports headless automation via CLI, SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java), scheduled Python jobs (Flights) for ingest/transformation, and credential persistence for non-interactive sessions, all of which are usable in CI pipelines; dbt integration further supports automated pipelines.
